items.quote: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
items.claim: Moses questions Aaron and says Aaron is responsible for bringing a great sin on the people.
items.mechanism: questioning Aaron's leadership responsibility for the people's sin

items.quote: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
items.claim: Aaron asks Moses not to be angry and blames the sin on the people, saying they are set on mischief.
items.mechanism: appealing to the people's bad character to excuse himself
